purpose: Scoped primary-source audit of a claimed DC1 proof; retain the root-count and conditional Laurent lemmas and a precise one-root normalization countercontrol without adopting or refuting the main theorem.

Prove that an additional condition of the actual simultaneous Weyl pair/normal forms eliminates C, or repair the induction and terminal-edge transport while retaining it.
primary_source.indexing_resolution: With D=d2*N+l2, the consistent compressed formula is c[n,D*j]=c[d2*j], or raw formula c[n,(D/d2)*i]=c[i] on the relevant divisible indices. Thresholds use the same convention. An independent conditional Laurent proof bypasses the ambiguous displayed source formula; no fatal gap or whole-proof verification is claimed.
primary_source.conditional_step_verified: All prefix distinguished coefficients are independent of N under the exact head, final-order, trace and exceptional normalization hypotheses stated in CONDITIONAL_LAURENT_COEFFICIENT_INVARIANCE.md. The gap dichotomy follows from integrality; the complete exceptional resonance is proved. Earlier constructions supplying those hypotheses remain unverified.

later_primary_assessment.title: The generalized Dixmier conjecture and the two-dimensional Jacobian conjecture

independent_result.statement: For c*g^A=g*H'-(A-1+1/d)*g'*H with c nonzero, characteristic zero, and g of degree ell with s>=2 distinct roots, g^(A-1)*rad(g) divides H, deg(H)=(A-1+1/d)*ell, d divides ell, and ell/d>=s.
independent_result.evidence: Complete written root-valuation and infinity-degree proof, independent of the paper's formal normal-form framework.
independent_result.sharp_control: For d>=2 and A>=1, g=x^(d+1)*(x-1)^(d-1), H=d*g^(A-1)*x*(x-1), c=1 satisfy the equation and ell/d=s=2.
independent_result.finite_controls: Exact symbolic substitution checked for d=2,3,4 and A=1,2,3; the written substitution proves the entire displayed control family.
independent_result.scope: Necessary polynomial-ODE condition only; no DC1, finite Weyl mate, or global lifting conclusion.

conditional_invariance_result.statement: For a fixed pth-power chopping chain with all intermediate heads on a common D-lattice, zero trace coefficient, prescribed final order and the exceptional missing-head normalization when applicable, every prefix distinguished Laurent coefficient is independent of N. The last gap is automatically>N+1 except for C=1,d0=2,l0=1, when it is N; boundaryN+1 is impossible.
conditional_invariance_result.proof: Compressed backward binomial head root; exact derivative coefficient; nonlinear-order induction; complete exceptional quadratic-term cancellation; separate cyclic-vector trace, filtered tail and Puiseux trace lemmas with explicit assumptions.
conditional_invariance_result.nonresonant_control: p=4,q0=6,q1=22,d0=2,l0=1 gives final distinguished coefficient -231/512 and prefix -231/2048 for N=3,5,9.
conditional_invariance_result.resonant_control: p=4,q0=6,q1=16 gives final head-minus-one16v and distinguished192v; v=0 removes the dangerous term. Nonzero v are deliberate controls violating the normalization hypothesis.
conditional_invariance_result.scope: Conditional scalar commutative Laurent lemma. No assertion that earlier primary constructions supply all hypotheses; no DC-pair existence, integer-polynomial dependence or main DC1 adoption.

checker_scope: Independent Fraction Laurent finite controls and cyclic-vector sums. The all-N claim follows from the written proof, not finite extrapolation. The local polynomial-ODE lemma has a complete written proof and sharp symbolic family.

one_root_branch_control.proved_local_statement: The complete one-root polynomial ODE solution includes C*u^(d*beta+d/l) when l divides d. An exact two-stage coefficient recursion and both ODEs retain C and fit the displayed numerical order/gcd/distance data. For the l2,d4 example the simultaneous-centering difference is 3/(92*C), nonzero for C!=0.
one_root_branch_control.remaining_obligation: Prove that an additional condition of the actual simultaneous Weyl pair/normal forms eliminates C, or repair the induction and terminal-edge transport while retaining it.
one_root_branch_control.boundary: No initial simultaneous Weyl pair or first chop is realized by these local controls; no theorem or main-proof refutation is asserted.
